description: [Sentiment Desk] fAlpha's daily news sentiment score for a ticker, with the articles it was computed from and the date of the reading. For questions like 'what is the news saying about AMZN'; falpha_sentiment_desk_trend covers how it has moved. Available without an account.

ticker.description: US-listed equity symbol in fAlpha's covered universe, e.g. NVDA. falpha_screener_desk_coverage reports whether a symbol is covered.
ticker.title: Ticker

window_days.description: Window in days, 5 to 180. The score is the newest daily reading inside it.
window_days.title: Window Days

name: falpha_sentiment_desk
title: News sentiment
